name: WTS
recent: WTS Capital 近期获得 WPS 软件产品的分销权，并与 WPS 签订金级代理协议。公司于 9 月完成从 Systech 更名为 WTS Capital，并实施最高 4000 万令吉的股本削减。最新季度营收环比下降 44.6%，但同比大增 906.3%，并实现盈利。
notable: 获得 WPS 软件产品分销权，并签订金级代理协议。
完成公司名称变更，由 Systech Bhd 改为 WTS Capital Berhad。
股东大会通过最高 4000 万令吉的股本削减。
risks: 执行董事 Datuk Wira Lim Ying Ran 在闭门期内外多次交易公司股份。
大股东 Gan Thiam Seng 近期多次申报股权变动。
董事 Dr Low Min Yew 在闭门期外交易公司股份。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 1.520 亿令吉，环比下降 44.6%，同比大增 906.3%；净利润为 145 万令吉，净利率 1.0%，较上季度的 -0.6% 转正。

recent_en: WTS Capital recently secured distributorship for WPS software products and signed a gold-tier agency agreement with WPS. The company completed its name change from Systech to WTS Capital in September and implemented a share capital reduction of up to RM40 million. Latest quarterly revenue fell 44.6% QoQ but surged 906.3% YoY, turning profitable.
notable_en: Secured distributorship for WPS software products and signed a gold-tier agency agreement.
Completed name change from Systech Bhd to WTS Capital Berhad.
Shareholders approved a share capital reduction of up to RM40 million.
risks_en: Executive Director Datuk Wira Lim Ying Ran traded shares multiple times during and outside the closed period.
Substantial shareholder Gan Thiam Seng filed multiple changes in shareholding recently.
Director Dr Low Min Yew traded shares outside the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM152.0 million, down 44.6% QoQ but up 906.3% YoY; net income was RM1.45 million with a net margin of 1.0%, turning positive from -0.6% in the previous quarter.
